pairs.target: guǒ guàn dìèrtiān zhōngyú zhuāngjìn kuāng , tǎ wéi fùqián shí , bǐ zhǎngguì hái shèbùdé nà tuán diàn zài dǐxià de gāncǎo .
pairs.english: The fruit jar finally went into a basket the next day. Paying, Tavi was even more protective than the innkeeper of the dry grass padding underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 果罐第二天终于装进筐，塔维付钱时，比掌柜还舍不得那团垫在底下的干草。

pairs.target: tā zǒng juéde zài tiān yìdiǎn cái búhuì suì , zhǎngguì què ràng tā kàn , cǎo zài sāi , nèi gài dōu yào bèi dǐng kāi le .
pairs.english: He kept feeling more padding would prevent breakage, but the innkeeper showed him that more grass would push the inner lid open.
pairs.hanzi: 他总觉得再添一点才不会碎，掌柜却让他看，草再塞，内盖都要被顶开了。

pairs.target: xìndài yǐ zài zǎo chēshàng sòngzǒu , guǒ kuāng dé lìngjì yíjiàn . chēfū jiāng shéng līn qǐlái , diān le yíxià , tǎ wéi de shǒu yě gēnzhe wǎng shàng tái , rě dé yù hé xiào zhe wèn , shìbushì lián hún yě jì jìnqù le .
pairs.english: The mailbag had left on the morning cart; the fruit basket needed a separate entry. The driver lifted and bounced it by the cord, Tavi's hands rising with it. Yuhe laughingly asked if he had packed his soul inside too.
pairs.hanzi: 信袋已在早车上送走，果筐得另记一件。车夫将绳拎起来，颠了一下，塔维的手也跟着往上抬，惹得郁禾笑着问，是不是连魂也寄进去了。

pairs.target: nà yírì tāmen bǔwán le jiēkǒu jǐchù chǐcùn .
pairs.english: That day they finished the remaining junction measurements.
pairs.hanzi: 那一日他们补完了街口几处尺寸。

pairs.target: dào zài xià yìtiān , shū yàn yuē dàjiā zǒulù shí , chūn shì zuì jǐ de jǐrì yǐjīng guòqù , tānzi shǎo le yìxiē , shíjiē páng réng yǒurén xiē zhe , děng lái jiē shānhuò de dàchē hái méi dào qí .
pairs.english: By the following day's walk arranged by Shuyan, the spring market's most crowded days had passed. There were fewer stalls, people still rested beside the steps, and not all the large produce-collection carts had arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 到再下一天，舒砚约大家走路时，春市最挤的几日已经过去，摊子少了一些，石阶旁仍有人歇着，等来接山货的大车还没到齐。

alignment.english: all the large produce-collection carts had arrived

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì láidezǎo , dài le lìng yígè chēfū , shǒulǐ méiyǒu jiù zhǔn dān , érshì yìgēn xuēpíng de mùtiáo .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He arrived early with another driver, carrying no old permit, but a flattened wooden strip.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜来得早，带了另一个车夫，手里没有旧准单，而是一根削平的木条。

pairs.target: tā ràng chēfū bǎ chángyòng chē kuān hé cháng xiāng wài shēn de dìfāng kè zài shàngmiàn , xiān gěi níng qí kàn , shuō zǒng bùnéng měi huí dōu děng chē zhēn kǎ zài lǐmiàn , zài wèn nǎ kuài mùtou duōchū bànchǐ .
pairs.english: She had the driver mark the usual cart width and the long crate's overhang on it, then showed Ningqi: they could not wait for another jam every time before asking which timber projected half a foot.
pairs.hanzi: 她让车夫把常用车宽和长箱外伸的地方刻在上面，先给宁岐看，说总不能每回都等车真卡在里面，再问哪块木头多出半尺。

pairs.target: níng qí jiāng mùtiáo fàngzài lùbiān , duì zhe yù hé de shù hé le yíbiàn , méi shuō suǒyǒu chē dōu néng zǒu , zhī wèn zhè yílèi chē huílái néng bunéng réng zhào zhège yàngzi zhuāng .
pairs.english: Ningqi set the strip beside the road and checked it against Yuhe's figures. She did not approve every cart, only asked whether this type could return loaded the same way.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐将木条放在路边，对着郁禾的数核了一遍，没说所有车都能走，只问这一类车回来能不能仍照这个样子装。

pairs.target: chēfū shuō ruò línshí jiā yìzhī héng xiāng , jiù búshì zhè tiáo mùtou néng suàn de le , hè zhǎngguì kàn tā yìyǎn , jiào tā bié dàoshíhòu yòu tì biérén shùnshǒu dài .
pairs.english: The driver said adding a crosswise crate would put it beyond that strip's calculation. Shopkeeper He glanced at him and told him not to casually carry extra goods for others when the time came.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫说若临时加一只横箱，就不是这条木头能算的了，贺掌柜看他一眼，叫他别到时候又替别人顺手带。

pairs.target: bì lán cóng rǎnfáng nà tóushàng lái , jīnrì méi bèi fàn guàn , shǒulǐ tí yìzhī kōng lǒu . tā dāngzhe jǐgè rén de miàn bèishàng qù , cóng péng biān zǒuxiàng shíjiē .
pairs.english: Bilan came up from the dye works carrying an empty basket instead of food pots today. Before everyone, she put it on her back and walked from the awning toward the steps.
pairs.hanzi: 碧岚从染坊那头上来，今日没背饭罐，手里提一只空篓。她当着几个人的面背上去，从棚边走向石阶。

pairs.target: lǒu zài zhuǎnjiǎo cā le yíxià mùtiáo , shēngyīn qīng dé jīhū tīngbújiàn , tā què tíngxià , bǎ nà yìjiǎo zhǐ gěi tāmen kàn .
pairs.english: The basket brushed the strip at the turn, almost inaudibly, but she stopped and showed them that corner.
pairs.hanzi: 篓在转角擦了一下木条，声音轻得几乎听不见，她却停下，把那一角指给他们看。

pairs.target: chēfū dītóu liáng le liáng , shuō zìjǐ zhànjìnqù jiù guòbúqù le .
pairs.english: The driver bent to measure and said if he stood there, she could no longer pass.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫低头量了量，说自己站进去就过不去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu dào zuórì liúxià de fěn jì páng , ràngchū bàngè shēnzi , xiǎng kànkàn lǒu jiūjìng kǎ zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped beside yesterday's chalk mark, shifting half his body aside to see exactly where the basket caught.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走到昨日留下的粉记旁，让出半个身子，想看看篓究竟卡在哪里。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì běn yàoshuō chē kěyǐ zài wǎngqián , níng qí què jiào tā biédòng jiǎo , xiān ràng bì lán zhào yuán lù tuìhuílái .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He was about to suggest moving the cart forward, but Ningqi told Tavi to keep his feet still and let Bilan backtrack first.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜本要说车可以再往前，宁岐却叫他别动脚，先让碧岚照原路退回来。

pairs.target: nà bànbù ruò rànggěi chē , lùpái pángzhàn rén de wèizhì jiù méi le .
pairs.english: If that half step went to the cart, the standing space beside the sign vanished.
pairs.hanzi: 那半步若让给车，路牌旁站人的位置就没了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cè guò shēn , bēilǒu cā guò tā yīxiù , tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ jǔ péng gān shí zhàn zài shíjiē kǒu de yàngzi .
pairs.english: Tavi turned sideways as the basket brushed his sleeve, remembering how he had occupied the steps' entrance holding the awning pole.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维侧过身，背篓擦过他衣袖，他想起自己举棚杆时占在石阶口的样子。

pairs.english: This time, without being pushed, he asked whether they should draw the waiting space too, rather than only what remained after carts stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 这回没等人推，他先问，是不是该把候车的地方也画出来，不能只画车停下以后还剩的空。

pairs.target: yù hé gěi tā yì jié fěn . tā dūnxià , zài lùbiān jiù kuāng wèizhì liú le liǎnggè néng zhàn rén de xiǎoquān ,
pairs.english: Yuhe gave him chalk. He crouched and drew two small standing circles at the old basket position beside the road.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾给他一截粉。他蹲下，在路边旧筐位置留了两个能站人的小圈，

pairs.english: Bilan said the circles were not enough: with a basket and people pressing behind, she might need more. She stood there so he could include the basket's rim.
pairs.hanzi: 碧岚说圈不够，自己背着篓，后头人会催，便索性站过去，让他将篓沿也算进去。

pairs.target: chēfū gēnzhe hòutuì , tuī le tuī kōngchē , lúnzǐ méi yājìn quānlǐ , qiántou què dǐng dào nà jiā záhuòpù de ménbǎn .
pairs.english: The driver backed up and pushed the empty cart. Its wheels missed the circles, but its front struck the general store's door panel.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫跟着后退，推了推空车，轮子没压进圈里，前头却顶到那家杂货铺的门板。

pairs.target: pù lǐ de nánrén zǒu chūlái , zìjǐ jiàng ménbǎn xièxià yíshàn , yòu zhǐzhe lǐmiàn shuō , zhī jiè zhè jǐtiān , huò míngwǎn jiù dào , bùnéng zhēn bǎ diàn jiè chéng chēchǎng .
pairs.english: The shopkeeper came out and removed one door panel himself, saying the loan was only for these days: his stock arrived tomorrow night, and the shop could not truly become a cart yard.
pairs.hanzi: 铺里的男人走出来，自己将门板卸下一扇，又指着里面说，只借这几天，货明晚就到，不能真把店借成车场。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì wèn néng jiè nǎjǐgè shíchén , tā jiǎngwán , tā zài mùtiáo bèimiàn jì le liǎngháng , zhòuméi shuō zhè yě zhī gòu pái jǐliàng .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He asked which hours he could offer, noted two lines on the strip's back, and frowned that this allowed only a few carts.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜问能借哪几个时辰，他讲完，她在木条背面记了两行，皱眉说这也只够排几辆。

pairs.target: " xiānpái dé xià zhè jǐliàng . " shū yàn shuō , " shèngxià de bié yìqǐ kāi jìnlái . "
pairs.english: “Start with those few,” Shuyan said. “Don't bring all the rest in together.”
pairs.hanzi: “先排得下这几辆。”舒砚说，“剩下的别一起开进来。”

pairs.target: tāmen zài lùbiān shuō le hěn jiǔ , zuìhòu zhī dìngxià sān zǎo de shìxíng , xià yìpī tóngyàng chǐcùn , tóngyàng zhuāng fǎ de chē fēn shí jìn , búshì gěi měiliàng dàchē fā tōngháng huà .
pairs.english: They talked a long time by the road and agreed only to a three-morning trial, staggered entry for the next batch of carts of the same size and loading pattern, no blanket permission for every large cart.
pairs.hanzi: 他们在路边说了很久，最后只定下三早的试行，下一批同样尺寸、同样装法的车分时进，不是给每辆大车发通行话。

pairs.target: shíjiē kǒu liúrén zǒu , cāng qián xiān téng yíkuài děnghòu dì , lún dào de chē zài guǎijìnlái ;
pairs.english: The steps' entrance stayed for pedestrians, with waiting space first cleared before the warehouses; carts would turn in only at their turn.
pairs.hanzi: 石阶口留人走，仓前先腾一块等候地，轮到的车再拐进来；

pairs.target: kàn lù de rén yóu shū yàn lìng yuē běndì gōng , gōngqián dānliè , bùnéng ràng bì lán fàngxià fàn guàn bái zhàn , yě bùnéng zhī děng cāng xíng hǎn fàng cái fàng .
pairs.english: Shuyan would separately hire local passage workers, with wages itemized. Bilan would not abandon her food pots for unpaid duty, and passage could not depend solely on the warehouse firms' calls.
pairs.hanzi: 看路的人由舒砚另约本地工，工钱单列，不能让碧岚放下饭罐白站，也不能只等仓行喊放才放。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì dāying chū shìxíng de qián , què bǎ rìhòu de yǎnglù zhàng réng liú zhe .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He agreed to fund the trial but kept future road-maintenance accounts open.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜答应出试行的钱，却把日后的养路账仍留着。

pairs.target: tā shuō jīnrì néng xiè jǐliàng huò shì yì huíshì , zhè yíjì guòhòu shuí lái bǔ lù yòu shì lìngyìhuíshì , huíqù yào bǎ gèjiā de shù dàidào hé lù suǒ , bùnéng ná zhè sān zǎo dàngchéng zài búyòng tán de píngjù .
pairs.english: She said unloading a few carts was one matter, paying for repairs after the season another; she would take each firm's figures to the Joint Routes Office, not let these three mornings become an excuse to stop discussing it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说今日能卸几辆货是一回事，这一季过后谁来补路又是另一回事，回去要把各家的数带到合路所，不能拿这三早当成再不用谈的凭据。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng diǎntóu , gàosù tā shàngcéng cháng kuà réng bù kāi , níng qí yào tiān de cèdiǎn hái dé děng xīn jià gōng de ānpái .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng nodded and told her the upper long span remained closed; Ningqi's extra measuring points still awaited arrangements for new riggers.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡点头，告诉她上层长跨仍不开，宁岐要添的测点还得等新架工的安排。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dìshàng nà jǐgè quān kàn le yíbiàn , jiào tǎ wéi huà jìn túlǐ , liú zhe shìxíng shí duìzhào , bù jí zhe jiāng " néng guò " liǎnggè zì xiěshàngqù .
pairs.english: He examined the circles on the ground and told Tavi to add them to the diagram for comparison during the trial, not rush to write “passable.”
pairs.hanzi: 他将地上那几个圈看了一遍，叫塔维画进图里，留着试行时对照，不急着将“能过”两个字写上去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn luó dí lái hái páozǐ , shùnbiàn wèn tǎ wéi hòu rì hái zài bu zài , tángxiōng yào shōu yìpī cǎo dài , qǐng tā lái chīfàn .
pairs.english: That evening Luodi returned the plane and asked whether Tavi would still be there the day after tomorrow. His cousin was receiving grass bands and invited him to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚罗荻来还刨子，顺便问塔维后日还在不在，堂兄要收一批草带，请他来吃饭。

alignment.english: whether Tavi would still be there

pairs.english: Tavi said he had to check the schedule first. Luodi nodded: he would not save the last piece of meat for him; come late and only beans would remain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说要先问行程，罗荻便点头，说自己可不替他留最后那块肉，晚来就只剩豆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huí fáng hòu xiān zhǎochū gěi xuégōng liú de jìlù , yòu náchū nà zhāng xī wā zhuǎn xiàn de jiù dàng hào .
pairs.english: Back in his room, Tavi first found the records kept for the academy, then took out the West Hollow transfer route's old archive number.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回房后先找出给学宫留的记录，又拿出那张西洼转线的旧档号。

pairs.target: zhuōshàng méiyǒu guǒ guàn le , kōng chūlái de wèizhì gānghǎo gòu tān zhǐ .
pairs.english: The fruit jar was gone from the table, leaving just enough room to spread his papers.
pairs.hanzi: 桌上没有果罐了，空出来的位置刚好够摊纸。

pairs.target: chuāngwài jiù hú nà dào dīshēng yòu qǐ , tā zhèhuí fēndechū fēng cóng nǎbiān chuī lái , què réng wàng bújiàn tā lìngyìtóu de jìn chù .
pairs.english: Outside, the arch's low tone rose again. This time he could tell which way the wind came from, but still could not see the far end.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外旧弧那道低声又起，他这回分得出风从哪边吹来，却仍望不见它另一头的尽处。
